items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training

UCLA Health runs and operates over 300 outpatient clinics located in Southern California with over 3,000,000 outpatient encounters annually. The Patient Access Organization (PAO) serves as the centralized access team for UCLA Health’s ambulatory enterprise, ensuring timely, convenient, and equitable access to care for patients and the communities we serve. Our teams oversee high-volume centralized scheduling and call center operations, new patient referral intake and navigation, enterprise template and capacity management, workforce training and quality oversight, and scheduling pathways and technology optimization, including decision tree development and digital innovations. We operate at the intersection of operations, technology, and clinical partnership to align supply and demand, streamline workflows, and continuously improve how patients enter and engage with UCLA Health.

The Executive Assistant/Special Projects Coordinator for the PAO provides professional analytical support, project coordination and management, as well as specialized and general administrative support. The incumbent is responsible for managing the Senior Director's calendar, correspondence, administrative tasks and various projects as assigned. This role will also support other leadership team members across the PAO.
Demonstrates the values of the organization: CICARE
Demonstrate commitment to serving both the internal and external customers.
Ability to multi-task and prioritize assignments to complete work in a timely manner despite competing priorities and conflicting deadlines.
Analytical skills to evaluate data, solve problems, draw conclusions and make sound recommendations.
Financial skills sufficient to calculate percentages, ratios, rates in order to: determine costs, provide financial projections, and prepare analytical reports.
Effective writing skills to develop concise, effective and professional business correspondence, presentations and reports

Effective verbal communications and interpersonal skills to actively listen, respond to the business need, and convey information concisely and professionally with individuals at all levels of the organization
Demonstrated skills in using various software, such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, in a Windows environment.
Ability to establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with staff, coworkers and public.
Ability to work independently and follow through on assignments with minimal direction
Ability to work with confidential and highly sensitive information with discretion.
Ability to establish and maintain positive, effective working relationships with peers, leaders, and staff.
Ability to work accurately with details.
Ability to demonstrate good judgement in all aspects of the job.
